packageRules.description: Tailwind 4 ships the engine and the PostCSS plugin in lockstep.
Type-only packages cannot change runtime behaviour; next build type-checks them.

React and its types move together; split PRs would not build. MUST stay after the @types/** rule above: both rules match @types/react, later rules win, and when this one sat first the types rule pulled @types/react into its own automerging PR -- so the types half could merge without the React bump, which is exactly what this rule exists to prevent. automerge is restated because a later rule overrides only the fields it sets.

Actions are pinned to commit SHAs, so a bump REWRITES the pin. Auto-merging that would undo the pinning it is meant to maintain: a compromised upstream release would land unreviewed on a repo whose scheduled jobs hold the production DATABASE_URL. A human reads the diff.

Majors need a human. (The old reason given here -- "this repo has no test suite, so the only gate is the Vercel preview build" -- is stale twice over: checks.yml now runs tsc and the full test suite, and preview deployments are off.)

SheetJS left the npm registry; the advisories have no fix there and never will. Build-time only (scripts/sync-scf.mjs, scripts/seed-csf-informative-refs.mjs), never shipped to a browser, and fed by files we choose. Revisit only as a migration to cdn.sheetjs.com.
